candidate.title: Coquitlam invites residents to mark storm drains
candidate.commercialFitReason: The official city notice creates practical local intent around home maintenance, waste disposal, environmental volunteering, and community-service contexts; article-level revenue, RPM, viewability, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.

evidence.readerImpact: Residents, community groups, and businesses can borrow a city kit, mark storm drains near them, and check safe disposal options before pollutants reach local streams.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: City of Coquitlam notice posted July 15, 2026; the city provides a sign-up page for storm drain marking.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: No existing Trends Today content covers Coquitlam storm drain marking, yellow fish markers, or the city's 17,000-drain waterway reminder.
